_comment: Copy to tools/smoke.json (git ignores it) and fill in your boards. Fields starting with _ are comments. docs/RELEASING.md says what each field does.

boards._comment: Ubuntu on an F50, updated online; ssh as ubuntu needs sudo without a password (sudo -n)
boards.name: f50-ubuntu

boards._comment: OpenWrt with the control panel on a U30 Air, from a mirror on the computer (MU300_RELEASE_URL=<mirror_url>/<tag>). Never sent to Android.
boards.name: u30-openwrt

boards._comment: OpenWrt on an F50, from a release directory on the device (mu300-update apply --from); --release-dir uploads it first
boards.name: f50-openwrt

boards._comment: The release's Magisk zip on an F50 that is in Linux now: sent to Android, the zip installed with magisk --install-module, back to Linux
boards.name: f50-magisk
